If I could only trade on $BTC setup  this would it be:

Price forms a move upwards and retraces back into a long poi (fvg, order block, demand zone, etc)

Now you look for two things:

1) a lower time frame break of structure
2) lows that keep holding

Once you spot that you long at current market price, put your stops below the most recent low and take profits at the first major resistance

This is by far my most favorite setup to trade and has worked very well for me.

Obviously this setup won't work everytime, like every other setup does but if it's used correctly it provides a very high winrate
